title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 34 (Rose Lake)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Rose Lake
34 That portion of the Province in the vicinity of the Town of Williams Lake, Cariboo Land District, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Those waters of Rose Lake to the maximum high water mark.
